scope: Priority slice of the work order: the Boas-vindas process and its acceptance. The rest of the work order is listed under not_done.
source_revision: base 41294f1a456da3f96abe0425bb4e16fc3b48eb16; this commit holds the code proved here

environment.session: interactive session of the station user, computer idle
environment.team: isolated synthetic team of the installed build (own data folder and vault namespace); the installed team was not used for the proof

scenarios.s1: Clean start through the app: only empty untitled tab reused, Boas_Vindas[2].txt, window closed, no session left.
scenarios.s2: Window already open with an unsaved synthetic tab, through the app: dedicated tab, only it closed, unsaved text kept, window open.
scenarios.s3: Restored session through the app: dedicated tab next to the restored one, restored text kept, window open.
scenarios.s4: Installed Runner CLI: two extra tabs of the run in its window closed, discard only on them, window closed.
scenarios.s4b: Installed Runner CLI: another tab in the window of the run kept with its text, window stays open, nothing discarded.
scenarios.s5: Collision through the app: a file appeared under the chosen name while Save As was open; the overwrite question was answered No, the other file was preserved and the save used the next free name.
scenarios.s6: Installed Runner CLI: target gone before the second step: NOTEPAD-TARGET-LOST before typing, nothing saved or opened.

acceptance.desktop_file: The file Boas_Vindas.txt already on the Desktop kept its hash in every run. Files of the runs were moved to the lab folder.

passed, with the regression for activation

review.by: independent read-only reviewer (subagent), two passes on the source; it did not write code
first_pass_blocking: a person's tab in the window of the run could be discarded
an empty read of the tabs counted as closed
POST /api/v1/jobs ran a linked step outside its process
review.fixed: All of them, plus changes to or archiving of the ready-made routines, and a re-check of the text at the moment of discarding.
review.accepted_limit: The Engine binds to the window, and the tab is checked before and after input. If another program opens a file in that window in the instant before input, the text may land there; the next check then stops the run.

defects_found_by_the_proof: Runner could not bring an open Notepad forward with the app in front: Windows refuses a background process. The Engine does it now, with an F24 key that nothing binds.
Engine always activated the root of a bound run in its first step, taking the focus from a dialog it owns. Fixed in engine-core/src/execute.rs, so the Engine hash changed; gate repeated.
The overwrite question is a task dialog: Esc and WM_CLOSE do not answer it. Now Enter on No, with the focus confirmed first.
open_points: The old boas-vindas template, still used by the release gate, closes with the title-bar X: Notepad keeps each saved tab for the next start. Each gate left 7 tabs, closed by hand in the lab before the proof. A customer running the old template gets the same.
The free-name base case (Boas_Vindas.txt itself) is covered by component tests only: that file already exists on the proof Desktop and was not moved.
s4 and s4b use the Runner CLI so that tabs can be added between steps; the steps themselves are the same code as through the app.
Windows 10 x64 was not exercised; no support is claimed.
Text may be autocorrected by Notepad; the Boas-vindas sentence was not changed in any run, and a change stops at NOTEPAD-TEXT-MISMATCH.
Installed app reopened on the real team: migration 005 applied with a pre-migration backup; its Boas-vindas process was not run there.
